data.description:
Found during the Etch rollout (ROLLOUT wave 0.5). This is the answer to the rollout risk 'capture silently breaks (binary moved, hooks dropped).' There is currently no single command to tell an operator whether Etch is actually working in a repo; the interim is a weekly 'query --since' spot check.

What it does: add an 'entire-agent-etch doctor' subcommand that reports, for the current repo, a health summary (human table + --json):
  1. Binary on PATH — is entire-agent-etch resolvable, and is it the same build as the one invoked? (path + version)
  2. Hooks present — are the 5 etch hook entries installed in .claude/settings.json (and/or settings.local.json)? Flag partial installs.
  3. Refspec state — is a refs/etch/sessions/* fetch/push refspec configured, and on which remote(s)? For a public repo, NO refspec is the correct state — report it as OK-for-public, not a warning (detecting public vs private is out of scope; just report the facts).
  4. Age of newest captured session — newest refs/etch/sessions/ commit time; warn if older than a threshold (suggest --warn-age, default e.g. 14d) since stale capture is the silent-breakage signal.
  5. Orphaned wip buffers — count .etch/sessions/*.wip.jsonl and the oldest one's age (a growing pile past recovery_timeout_hours indicates recovery isn't firing).

Acceptance criteria:
- 'doctor' exits 0 when healthy, non-zero when a hard problem is found (binary not on PATH, hooks missing/partial). Stale-age and no-refspec are warnings, not failures.
- '--json' emits a structured report with a field per check.
- Works in a repo with zero sessions (reports 'no sessions captured yet', not an error).
- Unit test in the temp-repo harness covers: healthy repo, hooks-missing repo, no-sessions repo, stale-newest-session repo.

Context: named in ROLLOUT wave 0.5 and the Risks table; referenced as the not-yet-shipped health check in code/platform/etch.md's query cheatsheet and gotchas.
data.title: etch doctor — capture health check

data.body: Scope note from ENABLEMENT.md: doctor should also check operator-mode state — etch.enabled key, per-worktree stamp coverage, core.hooksPath effectiveness, dedupe sanity. ETCH-48 adds these checks if doctor exists by then; otherwise they're part of this ticket.

Scope extension from ETCH-48 (operator mode shipped): doctor should additionally check (1) etch.enabled config key state — true/false/absent and which mode that implies; (2) per-worktree stamp coverage — every worktree of an operator-mode repo carries the guarded entries in .claude/settings.local.json, none stale after disable; (3) core.hooksPath effectiveness — flag the husky-style RELATIVE hooksPath case, where the post-checkout hook is resolved per-worktree and self-propagation silently does not fire for new worktrees (absolute hooksPath works; tested in ETCH-48); (4) dedupe sanity — a worktree with BOTH committed entries and a stamp should show the stamp yielding (grep guard present), flag if a stamp lacks the settings.json grep guard.

VALIDATION EVIDENCE: All four ticket ACs proven by tests (healthy/hooks-missing/partial → exit codes; --json field per all nine checks; zero-sessions repo healthy; stale-session warn + --warn-age countertest) — 18 tests in internal/doctor, PATH pinned per invocation for CI determinism, plus a read-only invariant (file-tree snapshot). Full suite green -count=1 locally under load and on CI (runs 27440125759, 27440994858). LIVE: doctor run on the Etch repo (team mode — all green, 4 live wips correctly identified as live sessions, not orphans) and on the c11 pilot (operator mode — 13/13 worktrees stamped, propagation + dedupe green, exit 0). Deliberate AC deviation flagged in PR: etch.enabled=false exempts hook-coverage from hard failure (explicitly disabled repo is healthy). Note for posterity: the binary check FAILs when entire-agent-etch is off PATH, hooks-coverage FAILs on gaps; everything else warns.

Shipped etch doctor (PR #6, squash-merged as d90f47e + review fixes). New internal/doctor package: nine read-only checks (binary on PATH/same build with hardened version probe; enablement key state; per-event hook coverage across committed+stamp sources; refspec posture with no-refspec-is-valid-for-public framing; newest-session age vs --warn-age; PID-aware wip buffers reusing recovery's liveness probe so live long-running sessions never false-alarm; per-worktree stamp coverage; post-checkout propagation incl. the relative core.hooksPath gap; dedupe-guard sanity incl. the grep-guard false-positive case). Human table + --json. Exit non-zero only on hard failures. Reuses enable/install/recovery internals via small exports — no parsing logic duplicated. Plan review PASS (5 minors folded in), code review PASS (4 minors folded in, incl. the now-demonstrated latency-test load flake → load-aware p90 assertion with spawn baseline). Docs: README doctor section, ROLLOUT risk line ✅, platform etch.md query-cheatsheet interim replaced (Forgejo 2c87fa1). Live-validated on Etch (team mode) and c11 pilot (operator mode), both healthy, both exit 0.
